command:
set -euo pipefail; echo PRECHECK=START; echo '--- gguf candidates ---'; find /cache /workspace -type f -iname '*.gguf' -printf '%s %p
' 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'qwen|Qwen' | sort -nr | head -50 || true; echo '--- all large gguf ---'; find /cache /workspace -type f -iname '*.gguf' -size +200M -printf '%s %p
' 2>/dev/null | sort -nr | head -30 || true; echo '--- llama binaries ---'; find /cache /workspace -type f -perm -111 -printf '%p
' 2>/dev/null | grep -E '/(llama-cli|llama-server|llama-bench|libllama\.so[^/]*)$' | head -50 || true; echo '--- llama source repos ---'; find /cache /workspace -maxdepth 6 -type d -name '.git' -printf '%h
' 2>/dev/null | grep 'llama.cpp' | head -20 | while read r; do echo $r; git -C $r rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true; done; echo '--- resources ---'; free -h; df -h /cache
